absolute_contrast_protocol.exposure_scenario: heat-only days reassigned to neither; smoke-only, both, and holiday status unchanged
absolute_contrast_protocol.distribution: joint multivariate normal coefficient draws using the fitted covariance submatrix
absolute_contrast_protocol.per_draw_intercept: calibrate each retained stratum intercept under factual exposures to its observed stratum outcome total, then hold that intercept fixed for the reassigned scenario
absolute_contrast_protocol.holiday_handling: holiday indicator may vary within stratum and remains in the design matrix in both scenarios
absolute_contrast_protocol.conditioning: condition on observed retained stratum totals; no baseline outcome-count uncertainty
absolute_contrast_protocol.interpretation: associational model contrast only; not causal and not an attributable fraction
absolute_contrast_protocol.covariance_psd_handling: Retain the raw covariance; if non-PSD, explicitly eigendecompose and set negative eigenvalues to zero for joint draws, report the projection and compare the PSD-draw interval against a local raw-covariance delta-method interval.

runtime.execution: hidden Start-Process with persistent stdout/stderr/status/PID; do not rerun after failure without reporting to root
